exercises.question: Which sentence best expresses a reflection on a past alternative?
options: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, mi vida habría sido diferente. [If I had taken another path, my life would have been different.]
Todos los días tomo otro camino para volver a casa después de trabajar. [Every day I take another path to return home after working.]
Tomé otro camino diferente para evitar las obras de la calle. [I took a different path to avoid the road works.]

exercises.sentence: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, ___ a elegir con cuidado.
exercises.english: If I had another opportunity, I would choose carefully again.
If I had taken another path, my life would have been different.

sentences: Primero, tomé un camino. [First, I took a path.]
Después, pensé en el otro camino. [Then I thought about the other path.]
Finalmente, concluí: «Si hubiera tomado otro camino, mi vida habría sido diferente». [Finally, I concluded: “If I had taken another path, my life would have been different.”]

exercises.question: Which verb means «to regret»?
options: arrepentirse [to regret]
preocuparse [to worry]
imaginar [to imagine]

exercises.sentence: No sé si voy a ___ de mi decisión.
exercises.english: I don't know if I will regret my decision.
I don't know if I will regret my decision.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, mi vida habría sido diferente.
options: If I had taken another path, my life would have been different.
If I took another path, my life would be different.
I took another path and my life was different.

exercises.sentence: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, volvería a elegir con cuidado.
options: If I had another opportunity, I would choose carefully again.
If I have another opportunity, I chose carefully again.
I had another opportunity and chose carefully.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera salido antes, habría llegado a tiempo.
exercises.english: If I had left earlier, I would have arrived on time.

options: No lo sé. Podría arrepentirme. [I don't know. I might regret it.]
No lo sé. Pueda arrepentirme. [I don't know. I may (subjunctive) regret it.]
No lo sé. Me arrepienta. [I don't know. I regret (subjunctive) it.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué habría pasado si hubieras elegido otro camino?

options: Mi vida habría sido diferente. [My life would have been different.]
Mi vida había sido diferente. [My life had been different.]
Mi vida ha sido diferente. [My life has been different.]
Volvería a elegir con cuidado. [I would choose carefully again.]
Vuelva a elegir con cuidado. [I choose (subjunctive) carefully again.]
Volví a elegir con cuidado. [I chose carefully again.]

template.prompt: Say that if you had made another decision, the result would have been different.
template.answer: Si hubiera tomado otra decisión, el resultado habría sido diferente.

template.prompt: Say that if you had another opportunity, you would choose carefully again.
template.answer: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, volvería a elegir con cuidado.

template.prompt: Say that if you had chosen another path, you would have met other people.
template.answer: Si hubiera elegido otro camino, habría conocido a otras personas.

template.prompt: Write two sentences: if you had had more information, you might have made another decision; however, now you think you learned something important.
template.answer: Si hubiera tenido más información, quizá habría tomado otra decisión. Sin embargo, ahora creo que aprendí algo importante.

template.prompt: Write two sentences: if you had chosen another option, some things would have been different; however, you do not know if the result would have been better.
template.answer: Si hubiera elegido otra opción, algunas cosas habrían sido diferentes. Sin embargo, no sé si el resultado habría sido mejor.

exercises.question: ¿Qué hace Fernando al principio de la historia?
options: Sigue a un ciervo hasta la fuente.
Busca a una mujer de ojos verdes en la ciudad.
Habla con Íñigo sobre su viaje a la ciudad.

exercises.question: ¿Qué le dice Íñigo sobre la fuente?
options: Que en la fuente vive un espíritu del mal.
Que el ciervo está enfermo y no puede correr.
Que los perros no conocen el camino de la fuente.

exercises.question: ¿Qué le cuenta Fernando a Íñigo?
options: Que ha visto a una mujer de ojos verdes.
Que ha vuelto a ver a su familia.
Que ha encontrado una casa cerca de la fuente.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo termina la historia?
options: Fernando cae al agua y el agua se cierra sobre él.
Fernando vuelve a casa con el ciervo.
La mujer sale del agua y se va con Íñigo.
